name: Childcare & Nannies
tagline: Nannies, babysitters, after-school care, night nanny
extra_prompt: You are booking for a childcare or nanny agency. Ask about the children's ages, any allergies or medical needs, the home environment, and the hours needed. Ask about pets, routines, and whether the family needs a regular or casual arrangement. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed at booking. Do not promise a specific carer without confirming availability.

kb.a: {price_note} Rates depend on the carer's experience, the hours, and the number of children. We confirm the rate when you book.
Every carer completes [your screening checks, e.g. police check and Working With Children Check] before they start with a family. Ask us for details before you book.
Carers hold [first aid and CPR qualification details] before they start. We can share the certificate expiry dates on request.
We try to help with last-minute care, subject to availability. Call us as early as possible so we can find a carer.
Yes, including night nannies for newborns. Overnight care is charged per night, and we confirm the times when you book.
Yes, we place live-in and live-out nannies. Tell us about your home set-up, hours, and any accommodation needs.
Yes, including school pick-ups. Tell us the school, the pick-up time, and who is authorised to collect your child.
Yes, we have newborn care specialists. Tell us your baby's feeding and sleep routine so the carer can follow it.
Yes, we care for twins and triplets. A multiples surcharge applies per hour, and it is shown in your booking.

kb.q: Do you care for children with special needs?
kb.a: Yes, experienced carers are available for children with additional needs. Tell us about your child's needs so we can match a suitable carer.
Yes, including domestic and international travel. Travel nanny is charged per day, so tell us the trip dates.
Yes, including weddings and corporate events. Event childcare is charged per hour, so give us the start and finish times.
Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee. Let us know as soon as you can so we can release the carer.
We hold [insurance type and provider] cover. Ask us for certificates before the first booking.

kb.q: How do I book a nanny?
kb.a: We match a carer to your family, arrange a meet-and-greet, and confirm the booking. The meet-and-greet carries no charge.
We service the local metro area. Ask us to confirm your suburb.

kb.q: Do you need my child's medical details?
kb.a: Yes, we need allergy and medical plans so carers can follow them. These are kept in restricted fields and shared only with the carer.

compliance.guidance: Childcare services are regulated by the state education and care authority (in Victoria, the Department of Education). Each worker needs a Working With Children Check and approved first aid. Your state authority sets the rules; check them before relying on this guidance.
items: Working With Children Check for each worker, with expiry
Approved first aid training for educators
